items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: not Chesterfield, Shube or somebody, the band leader or the advertising agency said

ctx.x: 1944. And Chesterfield -- '45. Chesterfield took the program over and they said -- not Chesterfield, Shube or somebody, the band leader or the advertising agency said, well, this is a Southern company, we can't have a mixed band for a Southern tobacco company. And we'll sneak them in later, in the back door.

So one day Teddy said -- Teddy and I used to be very good friends. And he said, "Are you going to do Chesterfield?" I said, "Sure, aren't you?" And he said, "No," and he got a funny look and he told me the story. So I called up the leader and said, "Look, I can't do it if my friends can't do it. I don't want to do it." And then I got thinking, Jesus, that's not really enough.
